title: Contextual checklist onboarding and empty-state guidance for Console dashboards
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Create a lightweight, contextual onboarding flow for first-time Console users that surfaces a persistent checklist and adaptive empty-state guidance across Dashboards, Rollouts, and Cost views. The design should reduce time-to-first-success, lower churn during trial, and make advanced features (rollouts/policy controls/cost insights) discoverable without modal-driven interruptions. Scope: 1) persistent contextual checklist component that appears in a rail/header and can be pinned/hidden; 2) empty-state variants for dashboards, rollout groups, and cost reports with personalized CTA templates; 3) in-product microguides and tooltip sequences tied to checklist progress; 4) minimal animation and accessibility-compliant patterns; 5) analytics hooks for completion, dismissals, and template usage. Out of scope for this ticket: backend onboarding scoring algorithm (handled by ENG-2988) and multi-tenant template sharing (future work). Design constraints: must fit existing Console layout grid, support translations, work on small laptop widths, and avoid blocking primary task flows. Success metrics: 25% lift in dashboard goal completion in first 14 days, 30% reduction in help-desk tickets mentioning "where to start", and 10% increase in rollout feature activation from new users.
acceptance_criteria: Persistent checklist component implemented in Figma with responsive variants and copy approved by PM
Three empty-state templates for Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost views with CTA flows and copy variations
Tooltip/microguide sequences prototyped in Figma and linked to checklist steps
Accessibility checklist passed (contrast, keyboard navigation, screen reader labels) and flagged in handoff notes
Analytics events documented (checklist_shown, step_completed, template_applied, checklist_dismissed) and handed to ENG
